title: Handley Page Halifax LK878
memorial_details: Large, vaguely rectangular, moss-covered stone with a black, rectangular plaque upper-centre of the front face. The dedication is in white, upper-case letters. Two rectangular planters/troughs stand in front of the stone containing twisted pieces of metal (presumably from the crashed Halifax). This crash is also commemorated at St Felix Church, Felixkirk (see 102083)
inscription: WORLD WAR II AIR CRASH/ 15TH JANUARY 1945/ ON ROUTE FROM TOPCLIFFE AIRFIELD/ HALIFAX MK III LK 878 - 1659 H.C.U. TOPCLIFFE/ CRASHED HERE ON 15TH JANUARY 1945 AT 2058 HOURS FLYING CIRCUITS AND LANDINGS/ TAKING OFF AT 2055 HOURS, DURATION OF FLIGHT ONLY 3 MINUTES/ CREW OF 9, ALL KILLED IN CRASH/ (names)
community_connection: local people affected, who erected it
